descriptive: user 2026-11-25 in whip-lead's chat: "run option 1"; random baseline reported as values beside each fine-tune, no verdict, no counts of comparisons

settings.seeds_source: E228's filed seeds (experiments/random_kl_share/results/predictions.json .settings.seeds); run.py stops if they differ
settings.probe_x_source: Fable 2026-11-25 (in-the-weeds choice): the odd part of the gain at the fine-tune's own size is well above bf16 noise, at 0.01-0.1 it would not be
settings.scale_cap_source: E228's (from E46 Amendment 1, experiments/regating_table/results/predictions_amend1.json), so the grid points coincide with E228's; Fable 2026-11-25 kept it
settings.target_gain_source: band [1.0028, 1.0973] log-odds: inside the form's one-sided floor gain >= 1 (local_faith.MIN_GAIN) so every match is read, about 0.1 wide as E228's kl_rel_tol 0.1 (Fable 2026-11-25 advised rel_tol 0.1 around 1; centred at 1.05 so the band's lower end passes the floor)

expected.control_zero: a zero change on every task's rows: gain, numerator and KL exactly 0; share nan (gain under the floor) in both the one-sided form and route_split's own
expected.control_fine_tunes: every one of the 48 states' route_split share equals its known3.json value exactly (float equality): same code, same saved file, same rows, same card type (NVIDIA L40, as E136, E147 and E299 read); any difference stops the run and goes to the lead
expected.random_rival_a: the share mostly measures how much of any output change flows through Gamma's gates: a random change scaled to a one log-odds gain reads a share near the fine-tunes' new-side values (0.12-0.42 in known3.json) or above, on most tasks, with seeds of one task agreeing in sign
expected.random_rival_b: the share separates structure: random changes read shares near 0 (well under the new sides' 0.12-0.42) or erratic in sign across a task's three seeds
expected.random_kl: no draw is matched to KL; from E228 (KL-matched draws at 5-30 times the fine-tune's size gained -0.7 to +0.6 log-odds), draws that reach gain 1 are expected at a scale above E228's KL-matched one and a KL above their fine-tune's
expected.random_status: no expectation filed: some draws may not reach gain 1 at either sign up to 100 times the fine-tune's size; each is reported with its largest gain and share nan

blind_to: the share of a random change is read at one scale per draw (gain about 1), far from each fine-tune's gain (1.6-23 log-odds): it says what the form reads for a random change of that output size on the trained answer, not at the fine-tune's gain; three draws per state; one decomposition (the released VPD)
positive_control: stage 0: the zero change (exact 0, share nan) and the 48 fine-tunes reproduced bit for bit
noise_floor: none needed beyond the exact control: no bar is read; the search band (above) is the only tolerance
